member.name: ChangeMarkerMargin.Class
member.summary: Displays a marker beside every visible marked line reported by an .
member.remarks: The source is queried on every render pass; a source that does not notify requires the host to invalidate the margin when its marked lines change. The margin draws a narrow bar in , sized like a diff-view change bar and narrower than the default reserved width of the base class, and its sample brush keeps it visible without configuration. A host assigns and for its own identity. The type is sealed, so a different shape needs a margin derived from .

member.name: SampleMarkerBrush
member.summary: The blue brush the margin installs as its default marker brush.

member.name: MarkerBrush
member.summary: The brush that draws the change markers.
